about: Pratibha sumi glyph library for the PRAMANA blog. Masters are cleaned monochrome potrace SVGs (seals, signatures and stray calligraphy removed), cropped to a square viewBox around the ink. They live outside public/ and src/, so Astro never serves or builds them. Watercolor variants are generated only for placed marks, into public/media/sumi/wc/<glyph>-<tone>.svg. Pick unused glyphs first (used_in empty) so each glyph appears once across the blog, never twice in one post.

filters.standard: feTurbulence + feDisplacementMap scale 0.016W, blur 0.0022W, rim spread 0.022W
filters.thin: feMorphology dilate (radius per glyph, default 0.0035W) before displacement scale 0.006W, blur 0.0012W, rim spread 0.012W
